```{r comparacion gen vs transposa}
# Neighboring adaptive genes (4 categories) with their own locus
genes_adapt <- tsv_raw %>%
  mutate(cepa = str_extract(Muestra, "^[^_]+")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(locus_vecino), !is.na(gen_vecino)) %>%
  inner_join(dicc_cat, by = "gen_vecino") %>%
  distinct(cepa, locus_vecino, gen_vecino, categoria)

# Coordinates + contig of the adaptive gene (from todos_cds)
coords_adapt <- genes_adapt %>%
  left_join(
    todos_cds %>%
      mutate(cepa = str_extract(Muestra, "^[^_]+")) %>%
      select(cepa, locus_tag, contig, start_gen = start, end_gen = end),
    by = c("cepa", "locus_vecino" = "locus_tag")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(start_gen)) %>%
  mutate(contig_num = str_extract(contig, "[0-9]+$"),
         start_ext  = start_gen - 200,
         end_ext    = end_gen   + 200)

# Hypomethylation window CENTERED ON THE GENE 
buscar_hipo_gen <- function(wig_full, enz) {
  wig_full %>%
    filter(score <= 0.5) %>%
    inner_join(coords_adapt, by = c("cepa", "contig_num"),
               relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
    filter(pos >= start_ext, pos <= end_ext) %>%
    mutate(zona = case_when(
      pos < start_gen ~ "upstream",
      pos > end_gen   ~ "downstream",
      TRUE            ~ "intra"
    )) %>%
    distinct(cepa, locus_vecino, gen_vecino, categoria, zona) %>%
    mutate(enzima = enz)
}

hipo_gen_all <- bind_rows(
  buscar_hipo_gen(wig_dam_full, "Dam"),
  buscar_hipo_gen(wig_dcm_full, "Dcm")
)

# Regulatory position only 
hipo_reg_gen_propio <- hipo_gen_all %>%
  filter(zona != "intra") %>%
  group_by(gen_vecino, categoria, enzima) %>%
  summarise(n_cepas = n_distinct(cepa), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(categoria, desc(n_cepas))

# regulatory hypomethylation on the gene itself vs. on the neighboring transposase 
comparacion_gen_vs_transposa <- full_join(
  hipo_reg_gen_propio %>% rename(n_gen_propio = n_cepas),
  hipo_reg_genes       %>% rename(n_transposa = n_cepas),
  by = c("gen_vecino", "categoria", "enzima")
) %>%
  mutate(n_gen_propio = tidyr::replace_na(n_gen_propio, 0L),
         n_transposa  = tidyr::replace_na(n_transposa, 0L))
hipo_reg_gen_propio %>% knitr::kable()
```

## 13. Model locus architecture
To illustrate the co-localization between hypomethylation in the vicinity of transposases and neighboring adaptive genes, two model loci are shown, each with a distinct architecture and functional category. The first, on the chromosome of strain DA63884, shows the multidrug transporter mdtM in a divergent orientation next to its neighboring transposase (ISNCY family, ISRor2). The second, on a plasmid of strain DA63210, shows the replication regulator repA in a codirectional orientation with its neighboring transposase (IS6 family, IS26). In both cases, dots mark the hypomethylated GATC/CCWGG sites (score ≤ 0.5) present within the represented region, distinguishing Dam and Dcm methylation by color.

```{r figure5}
# Draws a two-gene locus (one transposase + one neighboring gene) with hypomethylated Dam/Dcm sites 
plot_locus <- function(cepa_sel, locus_transposa, locus_vec, etiqueta_vecino,
                        titulo, color_vecino = "#2E86AB") {

  cds <- todos_cds %>% mutate(cepa = str_extract(Muestra, "^[^_]+"))
  tp  <- cds %>% filter(cepa == cepa_sel, locus_tag == locus_transposa)
  vc  <- cds %>% filter(cepa == cepa_sel, locus_tag == locus_vec)

  genes_df <- data.frame(
    molecule = titulo,
    gene     = c(etiqueta_vecino, "Transposase"),
    start    = c(vc$start, tp$start),
    end      = c(vc$end, tp$end),
    forward  = c(vc$strand == "+", tp$strand == "+"),
    tipo     = c("vecino", "transposasa")
  )

  #  methylation  to the genomic window 
  contig_n  <- str_extract(tp$contig, "[0-9]+$")
  rango_ini <- min(genes_df$start)
  rango_fin <- max(genes_df$end)

  # the legend always shows both keys,even when a given locus only has hypomethylation from one enzyme
  motivos_df <- bind_rows(
    wig_dam_full %>% mutate(enzima = "Dam"),
    wig_dcm_full %>% mutate(enzima = "Dcm")
  ) %>%
    filter(cepa == cepa_sel, contig_num == contig_n, score <= 0.5,
           pos >= rango_ini, pos <= rango_fin) %>%
    distinct(pos, enzima) %>%
    mutate(molecule = titulo,
           enzima   = factor(enzima, levels = c("Dam", "Dcm")))

  ggplot(genes_df, aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, y = molecule, fill = tipo, forward = forward)) +
    geom_gene_arrow(arrowhead_height = unit(8, "mm"), arrowhead_width = unit(3, "mm"),
                    arrow_body_height = unit(8, "mm")) +
    geom_point(data = motivos_df, aes(x = pos, y = molecule, color = enzima),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 4.2) +
    scale_color_viridis_d(name = NULL, drop = FALSE,
                          labels = c("Dam" = "Dam hypomethylated site (score \u2264 0.5)",
                                     "Dcm" = "Dcm hypomethylated site (score \u2264 0.5)")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("transposasa" = "grey60", "vecino" = color_vecino),
                       labels = c("transposasa" = "Transposase", "vecino" = etiqueta_vecino)) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2), color = guide_legend(nrow = 2)) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::comma, expand = expansion(mult = 0.02))  +
    labs(title = titulo, x = "Position (bp)", y = NULL, fill = NULL) +
    theme_genes() +
    theme(legend.position = "right",
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
          axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank())
}

# Panel A: cross-tabulate each resistance gene's hypomethylation window vs. its neighboring transposase's
etiquetas     <- c("CDS hypo", "Regulatory hypo", "No hypomethylation")
niveles_gen   <- c("Present + CDS hypo", "Present + regulatory hypo", "Present, no hypomethylation")
niveles_trans <- c("Present + CDS hypo (transposase)", "Present + regulatory hypo (transposase)", "Present, no hypomethylation")

crosstab_heatmap <- comparacion_resist %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    gen_lab   = factor(estado_gen,       levels = niveles_gen,   labels = etiquetas),
    trans_lab = factor(estado_transposa, levels = niveles_trans, labels = etiquetas)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::count(gen_lab, trans_lab, .drop = FALSE, name = "n_pares") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    concordante = gen_lab == trans_lab,
    etiqueta = dplyr::case_when(
      n_pares == 0 ~ "",
      gen_lab == "No hypomethylation" & trans_lab == "CDS hypo" ~ paste0(n_pares, "\n(all mdtM)"),
      TRUE ~ as.character(n_pares)
    ),
    n_pares_fill = ifelse(n_pares == 0, NA, n_pares)
  )

panel_a <- ggplot(crosstab_heatmap, aes(x = trans_lab, y = fct_rev(gen_lab), fill = n_pares_fill)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = etiqueta, fontface = ifelse(concordante, "bold", "plain")),
            color = "white", size = 4.5, lineheight = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Gene-strain\npairs", na.value = "grey90") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) stringr::str_wrap(x, width = 10)) +
  labs(x = "Neighboring transposase window", y = "Own adaptive gene window") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.title = element_text(margin = margin(b = 10)),
        legend.key.height = unit(1.1, "cm"),
        legend.key.width = unit(0.5, "cm"),
        plot.margin = margin(10, 20, 10, 10))

  titulo          = "mdtM_panel",
  color_vecino    = "#F4A261"
) + labs(title = NULL) + theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# Combine all four panels into the final Figure 5 and save
figura5 <- (panel_a + panel_b) / (panel_c + panel_d) +
  patchwork::plot_layout(heights = c(2, 1)) +
  patchwork::plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")

ggsave("Resultados/Figure5.jpg",
       figura5, width = 14, height = 8.5, dpi = 300, quality = 100)

figura5
```

## 14. Genomic context of transposases: extended neighbourhood and hypomethylation
For each transposase identified across the 28 strains, the three flanking genes on each side (left and right) are extracted based on genomic coordinates, regardless of whether they are functionally annotated or hypothetical. For each of these neighboring genes, Dam or Dcm hypomethylation is assessed in the regulatory position (upstream or downstream, excluding the CDS itself) within a ±200 bp window centered on the neighbor's own coordinates (not on the transposase's), keeping the same regulatory-hypomethylation criterion used throughout the rest of this work. This makes it possible to check whether the immediate genomic environment of the mobile element is epigenetically marked, and whether that mark depends on distance (in number of genes) from the transposase. As a control, the composition of this extended neighbourhood is also examined, since some of these flanking "genes" may themselves be other transposases rather than host genes.

```{r extraccion vecindario ampliado}
# Extract the 3 flanking genes on each side
trans_keys <- trans %>%
  mutate(cepa = str_extract(Muestra, "^[^_]+")) %>%
  transmute(k = paste(cepa, locus_tag)) %>%
  dplyr::pull(k)

cds_ord <- todos_cds %>%
  mutate(cepa  = str_extract(Muestra, "^[^_]+"),
         is_tp = paste(cepa, locus_tag) %in% trans_keys) %>%
  arrange(cepa, contig, start) %>%
  group_by(cepa, contig) %>%
  mutate(idx = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()

transposasas <- cds_ord %>%
  filter(is_tp) %>%
  select(cepa, contig, locus_tp = locus_tag, idx_tp = idx)

vecindario_ampliado <- transposasas %>%
  tidyr::crossing(offset = c(-3, -2, -1, 1, 2, 3)) %>%
  mutate(idx_vec  = idx_tp + offset,
         lado     = ifelse(offset < 0, "izquierda", "derecha"),
         posicion = paste0(lado, "_", abs(offset))) %>%
  left_join(
    cds_ord %>% select(cepa, contig, idx,
                       locus_vec = locus_tag, gen_vecino = product,
                       start_vec = start, end_vec = end, strand_vec = strand),
    by = c("cepa", "contig", "idx_vec" = "idx")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(locus_vec))

vecindario_win <- vecindario_ampliado %>%
  mutate(contig_num = str_extract(contig, "[0-9]+$"),
         start_ext  = start_vec - 200,
         end_ext    = end_vec + 200)

cat("Transposasas:", nrow(transposasas),
    "| Relaciones transposasa-vecino:", nrow(vecindario_ampliado), "\n")
```

```{r busqueda hipometilacion vecinos}
# Hypomethylation (±200 bp) around each neighboring gene
buscar_hipo_vecino <- function(wig_full, enz) {
  map_dfr(unique(vecindario_win$cepa), function(cc) {
    wig_full %>%
      filter(cepa == cc, score <= 0.5) %>%
      inner_join(filter(vecindario_win, cepa == cc),
                 by = c("cepa", "contig_num"), relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
      filter(pos >= start_ext, pos <= end_ext) %>%
      mutate(zona = case_when(pos < start_vec ~ "upstream",
                              pos > end_vec   ~ "downstream",
                              TRUE            ~ "intra")) %>%
      distinct(cepa, locus_tp, posicion, locus_vec, gen_vecino, pos, zona)
  }) %>% mutate(enzima = enz)
}

hipo_vecindario <- bind_rows(buscar_hipo_vecino(wig_dam_full, "Dam"),
                             buscar_hipo_vecino(wig_dcm_full, "Dcm"))
```

```{r hipometilacion por distancia}
# Regulatory hypomethylation as a function of distance to the transposase (regulatory region only)
total_por_posicion <- vecindario_ampliado %>%
  dplyr::count(posicion, name = "n_total")

hipo_por_posicion <- hipo_vecindario %>%
  dplyr::filter(zona != "intra") %>%
  dplyr::distinct(cepa, locus_tp, posicion, enzima) %>%
  dplyr::count(posicion, enzima, name = "n_hipo")

resumen_pos <- hipo_por_posicion %>%
  dplyr::left_join(total_por_posicion, by = "posicion") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pct    = n_hipo / n_total,
                offset = as.integer(str_extract(posicion, "[0-9]$")) *
                         ifelse(str_detect(posicion, "izquierda"), -1, 1))

resumen_pos %>%
  dplyr::arrange(offset, enzima) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(posicion_en = ifelse(offset < 0, paste0("Left ", offset), paste0("Right +", offset))) %>%
  dplyr::select(posicion_en, enzima, n_hipo, n_total, pct) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Neighbor genes with regulatory hypomethylation by position relative to the transposase",
               digits = 3,
               col.names = c("Position", "Enzyme", "N hypomethylated", "N total", "Proportion"))

ggplot(resumen_pos, aes(x = factor(offset,
                                   levels = c(-3,-2,-1,1,2,3),
                                   labels = c("-3","-2","-1","+1","+2","+3")),
                        y = pct, fill = enzima)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", width = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 3.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(aesthetics = "fill", name = "Enzyme") +
  labs(title    = "Regulatory hypomethylation by distance to the transposase",
       subtitle = "Flanking genes \u00b11, \u00b12, \u00b13 | dashed line = transposase position",
       x = "Neighbor gene position (number of genes from the transposase)",
       y = "Genes with regulatory hypomethylation (%)", fill = "Enzyme") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

```{r composicion del vecindario}
# How many of the neighboring genes (±1, ±2, ±3) are actually other transposases?
vecindario_ampliado <- vecindario_ampliado %>%
  dplyr::mutate(vecino_es_transposasa = paste(cepa, locus_vec) %in% trans_keys)

# Overall summary
vecindario_ampliado %>%
  dplyr::count(vecino_es_transposasa) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)) %>%
  knitr::kable(
    caption = "Composition of the extended neighbourhood: transposase vs. non-transposase neighbors",
    col.names = c("Neighbor is a transposase", "N relationships", "Percentage (%)")
  )

# Breakdown by position
vecindario_ampliado %>%
  dplyr::count(posicion, vecino_es_transposasa) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(posicion) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::arrange(posicion, vecino_es_transposasa) %>%
  knitr::kable(
    caption = "Composition of the extended neighbourhood by position relative to the transposase",
    col.names = c("Position", "Neighbor is a transposase", "N relationships", "Percentage (%)")
  )
```
